<!-- pr-reviewer: 5858d89286dd16aa840d32ac449c0f5454bd9788 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

### What looks good
- `assets/posts/grblhal.cps:713` and `assets/posts/tormach.cps:1081`: the refusal is in `onCycle` before `spindleStopped`, `xyFirst`, `cycleSeat` and the `block(...)` calls. A refused G83 writes no G83, G80, G98 or G99 block. Before the refusal, only `seeZ` (grblHAL) and `indexFor` (Tormach) run. They change the state and write no cycle block.
- The refusal reaches the user. `msg()` gives a counted warning, and `crates/app/src/posting.rs:595` blocks the full post on any warning ("post blocked - N warning(s): ..."). Thus no partial program is written.
- The test `g83_dwell_linuxcnc` pins zero dwell: G83 has one block with `Q3` and no P word, and there are no warnings.
- G82, G86 and G89 are not changed. The `P` line (`grblhal.cps:731`, `tormach.cps:1099`) is not changed, and `ream_cycle`, `cycle_hop` and the script suites pass.
- The pin is real. When I put back the two post files from `origin/main`, `linuxcnc_family_refuses_a_g83_dwell_by_name` fails, and the zero-dwell test passes.
- There is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` on a user path. The only ones are in the test file. The new test file has a provenance header and a Gate map, and it is in `crates/post` (the lowest crate). The decision file has the public sources and the dropped options. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #2348`.
- No golden or snapshot PNG changed. No CR bytes are in the four changed files. The 400-line rule does not apply to `.cps` files.

### Results, merged with main (`94f7d6b89`), local, debug, `-j 6`
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with `origin/main` | clean |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all 76 test binaries, lib and doc tests included) | 657 passed, 0 failed |
| of which `g83_dwell_linuxcnc` | 2 passed |
| of which `script_grblhal` / `script_tormach` / `cycle_hop` / `ream_cycle` | 11 / 11 / 7 / 5 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test grblhal_post --test tormach_post --test recorded_post_streams` | 9 / 10 / 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Pin check (post files from main, PR test) | refusal test fails, as it must |

I did not run the full quick-gate plan or other `camcraft-app` suites.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. `grblhal.cps:713` writes the warning one time for each refused hole. A drill operation with many holes gives the same line many times. The Tormach feed refusal uses a once-flag (`feedRefused`). A once-flag here can make the message shorter. This is a polish item only. Each warning still blocks the post.
2. The dwell value goes into the message without formatting (for example `0.001 s`). This is correct and the test pins it.
3. PR #2048 uses the same message text for the Fanuc family. If one of the two PRs changes the text, change the other PR too.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
